verdict.rationale: mise supports some automatic event-driven behavior — auto-switching tool versions/env vars on directory enter/leave and `mise watch` to rebuild on file changes — but this is limited to a few built-in triggers rather than a general-purpose rule/event engine a user can define arbitrarily. Missing for 10: a documented mechanism to define custom triggers (e.g., on git push, on file save, on external webhook) mapped to arbitrary actions, and independent confirmation of watch/auto-switch reliability beyond docs.
